title: NIKE, Inc. Apparel Design Internship
note: Soft-goods apparel design internship across Global Sports Apparel for final-year students graduating in 2027; includes relocation assistance.

facts.summary: Paid 10-week internship supporting apparel product creation across Nike's sport categories (Olympics, NBA, NFL, football, golf and more).
facts.duties: Help designers create and finalize apparel details using 2D and 3D tools, take part in proto reviews and cross-functional meetings, prepare product requests.
facts.requirements: Final-year student graduating Spring–Winter 2027 in apparel design, technical design or related; portfolio of 3–5 apparel projects; Adobe CC and Illustrator required; CLO or similar 3D tools a plus.
facts.apply: Apply online through Nike's Workday careers posting with portfolio.
